complexity_ledger.narrative: specs/results/scorecards/stabilize-substrate/SS-04/RESULT.md -- the full write-up. In brief: SS-04 adds FORM P to `scope`, a recogniser for `<n> of <m>` counted figures in ORDINARY PROSE, because `CA-08-DF-01` measured the instrument at ZERO counted figures on the charters, the ticket plan, four goal baselines and a price table, all of which were being swept the whole time -- the bound was the SENTENCE FORM, not the corpus. COMPLEXITY: the model delta is ZERO and the added representation is entirely inside an eval-harness file that `representation_scope` places OUT of model, so nothing here widens the program surface. WHAT LICENSES THE ADDED CODE: `scope` is on the do-not-cut list and the plan says EXTEND IT, DO NOT REPLACE IT, so the addition is additive by construction -- FORM P cannot return REFUTED and cannot return HOLDS, its verdict set is asserted over all 2,887 of its rows rather than promised, and `scope --form bound` reproduces the base output byte-for-byte at 103 / 81 / 0 / 2 / 20. MEASURED ALTERNATIVES CONSIDERED AND REJECTED: (1) a paragraph-wide matching window, rejected because it is exactly what lets a figure bind to a scope three sentences away, which is the defect R3 exists to refuse; (2) letting FORM P re-derive numerators and return REFUTED, rejected because a prose figure binds no value to a dimension, so a REFUTED would be invented -- and A FALSE REFUTED IS WORSE THAN AN UNREACHABLE; (3) widening the recogniser until the five figures the issue names all parse, REFUSED AS MF-020 and pinned by a test that fails if a later hand does it. FINDINGS THE MACHINE-CHECKED CORE CANNOT EXPRESS: five, `SS-04-DF-01` through `SS-04-DF-05`, ledger 334 -> 339. Two of them are defects in this ticket own deliverable found by hand-auditing its output (42 of 88 COUNT-MOVED rows were counting ledger rows, not cards; a greedy noun capture ate the next figure numerator), one is a latent crash that predates the ticket by five card versions (`KeyError: D5` killed the whole command, taking every other figure answer with it), and one is that every documented `python3 score_tools.py` invocation dies with a traceback under a python3 below 3.11 -- which made this ticket own document sweep report ten zeroes before it was caught, and A ZERO FROM A CRASHED INTERPRETER IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM A ZERO FROM A BLIND RECOGNISER. TWO OF EIGHT SEALED PREDICTIONS FAILED, both about how much counted prose this record carries, both in the direction that says the blindness was worse than estimated. Recall against a separate deliberately over-broad scanner is 3,305 of 5,790 = 57.1%, with every miss in a category declared BEFORE measuring.

summary: SS-04: FORM P reads <n> of <m> counted figures in ORDINARY PROSE, so scope can read the documents that direct the work. Whole record 103 -> 2,990 figures (2,930 the record's, 60 this ticket's own documents) over 369 swept files, 258 carrying a figure; the 10 named work-directing documents 3 -> 271, and 9-of-10-reading-zero -> 0-of-10; this epic's own charter 0 -> 15, the predecessor's 0 -> 7. UNREACHABLE IS THE DEFAULT AND FORM P CAN RETURN NEITHER REFUTED NOR HOLDS -- verdict set asserted over all 2,887 of its rows, not promised -- so REFUTED held at 81, HOLDS at 2, the bound forms are byte-identical to base at 103/81/0/2/20, and NO EXIT CODE CHANGED for any input that resolves. SS-02's extension EXECUTED on this instrument: seven absent/unreadable/empty inputs answer UNDECIDED at exit 2 naming the state, against five byte-identical confident PASSes at exit 0 before, with a figure-free control that still exits 0 and says CHECKED, NONE FOUND; register population 2 of 56 -> 3 of 56, numerator only. SS-01-DF-03 CONSUMED: every run prints the tree it was swept in. SS-00-DF-04 CONSUMED AS A CLASS: scope computes and prints the file x verdict JOINT distribution, so the sentence that came from multiplying two marginals cannot be written from this output. MF-020: the shape was SEALED IN A COMMIT BEFORE THE CODE EXISTED, three of the five named figures are DECLARED MISSES with a test asserting they still miss, and 2 of 8 sealed predictions FAILED. Recall against a separate over-broad scanner 3,305 of 5,790 = 57.1%, every miss in a declared category. Five findings filed, ledger 334 -> 339, two of them defects in this ticket's own deliverable and one a latent crash that predates it by five card versions. NOTE: this summary is sealed BEFORE the workspace is deleted, so it CANNOT describe the post-close tree -- RESULT.md and FINAL-FIGURES.txt are authoritative for that.

assertions: scope reaches counted figures written as ordinary '<n> of <m>' prose, demonstrated on a NAMED COMMITTED LIST of work-directing documents including this epic's charter and the predecessor's.
UNREACHABLE IS THE DEFAULT. An uncertain sentence is UNREACHABLE, never HOLDS and never REFUTED.
NOT A GATE: nothing refuses, nothing blocks a close, no exit code changes.
MF-020 is honoured: the recogniser is demonstrated on prose whose answer was not known when it was written, and WHAT IT MISSES IS REPORTED.
The recogniser's own absent-input behaviour is demonstrated on an empty document, an absent path and a figure-free document, per SS-02's extension.
The whole-record sweep is re-run and every movement attributed with numerator/denominator named.
The card is unchanged: serve | wc -c is still 6,281 and the digest is stated.

ticket.objective: NAMED BY THE PREDECESSOR'S EVALUATION AS 'THE SUCCESSOR EPIC'S FIRST CANDIDATE', AND IT IS THE MOST USEFUL THING THAT EVALUATION FOUND. CA-08-DF-01: scope returns ZERO counted figures on the charter, the ticket plan, a goal baseline and a price table. THE CHARTER'S OWN CORRECTION BLOCK SAYS 'R3/scope WOULD HAVE CAUGHT THIS AND NOBODY RAN IT AGAINST THIS CHARTER' -- and when someone finally ran it, IT COULD NOT READ THE CHARTER. THE BOUND IS THE SENTENCE FORM, NOT THE CORPUS, AND THIS IS REVIEWER-CONFIRMED: those files ARE swept. scope recognises ONE form, 'D<n> = <v> on <n> of <m>', and '0 of 9 over the sealed table' is not in it. EVERY COUNTED FIGURE THAT HAS EVER HURT THIS PROJECT -- '0 of 9', '1 of 38', 'four rounds' claims', '8 failed, 1490 passed', 'seven epics, zero bugs' -- IS INVISIBLE TO THE INSTRUMENT NAMED TO CATCH IT. THE SHAPE IS GIVEN: a recogniser for '<n> of <m>' in ordinary prose THAT REPORTS UNREACHABLE BY DEFAULT. NOT A GATE. Nothing refuses, nothing blocks a close, nothing changes an exit code -- and note that the predecessor's own starter printed FOUR of five scope rows and carried a heading the dropped row refuted, so BE MORE CAREFUL WITH YOUR OWN OUTPUT TABLE THAN THE RECORD WAS WITH ITS. MF-020 IS THE HIGHEST RISK IN THIS TICKET AND IT APPLIES DIRECTLY: NEVER ADD AN AXIS, TEST, RUNG OR CASE FITTED TO A KNOWN ANSWER. Five figures are named above and you know their answers. A recogniser tuned until those five parse is fitted to a known answer and fails clause (d) even if it works. BUILD IT AGAINST PROSE WHOSE ANSWER YOU DO NOT KNOW, DEMONSTRATE IT ON THIS EPIC'S OWN CHARTER AND THE PREDECESSOR'S, AND REPORT WHAT IT MISSES. A FALSE REFUTED IS WORSE THAN AN UNREACHABLE: a claim the instrument cannot reach is NOT a claim that holds, the two counts stay separate on purpose, and if you cannot tell, say UNREACHABLE. R1 AND THE NEW ABSENT-INPUT EXTENSION BOTH APPLY: demonstrate a failing input on a real subject, AND demonstrate what your recogniser answers on an empty document, an absent path and a document with no figures at all -- if any of those answers 'no figures, all clear' rather than UNREACHABLE or a refusal, you have shipped the class SS-02 just wrote the rule against. RUN YOUR OWN RULE AGAINST THE SEALED RECORD BEFORE SHIPPING and report what it refuses. AND RE-RUN THE WHOLE-RECORD SWEEP: it was byte-for-byte identical at the predecessor's base and tip -- 102 figures, 80 REFUTED, 0 COUNT-MOVED, 2 HOLDS, 20 UNREACHABLE over 37 files -- so any movement you produce is YOURS and must be attributed with numerator/denominator named.
